name: Trail Saddle
defects: Right stirrup appears attached to a short, odd front flap rather than a proper long stirrup leather/fender.
The two stirrups are noticeably different in size and shape beyond perspective.
Some leather straps/fenders merge into the saddle body with unclear attachment points.

name: Trail Kettle
defects: Star-shaped opening on the lid is unusually large and irregular for a kettle vent.
Right handle segment is partly obscured by the bandana and appears slightly discontinuous/misaligned where it should connect to the side pivot.

name: Covered Wagon
defects: No obvious functional tow pole, shafts, or hitch for an animal are visible.
Wheel layout is ambiguous: only three wheels are clearly visible, with the fourth missing or completely hidden.
Visible wheels are different sizes; the center near wheel is much larger than the left and right wheels beyond normal perspective.
Right wheel is partly obscured and appears squeezed/merged into the wagon body and axle area.

name: Lasso Loop
defects: Large loop has no clear tied honda/knot or free end; both sides appear to merge into the red sleeve, making the lasso construction unclear.
Red sleeve/collar intersects the rope unrealistically, with rope segments seeming to enter or fuse into it rather than being tied around it.
Lower coil has no visible rope end and the rope path is ambiguous, making it look like a closed, fused spiral rather than one continuous rope.
Some rope strands in the lower coil appear to merge together instead of maintaining a consistent separate rope path.

name: Camp Lantern
defects: Right lower side support has no clear lower hinge; it appears to merge into the base/knob area.
Left and right side supports are slightly asymmetric in thickness and curvature.
Front adjustment knob is fused into the base with no visible shaft or mounting hardware.

name: Lucky Shoe
defects: Horseshoe tips have large rounded rectangular caps/blocks that look like extra fused parts rather than normal horseshoe ends.
Nail holes are not symmetrically paired: the left side shows more holes than the right, with an odd single hole at the bottom center.
Orange rope appears partially fused into the horseshoe tips instead of clearly wrapping around separate surfaces.
Central knot/loop construction is ambiguous and slightly melted together with the horizontal rope.
The turquoise bead hangs from the knot but its small orange connector is not clearly attached to a cord.

name: Saddle Rail
defects: Only one stirrup is visible; the matching stirrup on the opposite side is missing.
The visible stirrup strap/fender hangs from the center/front underside of the saddle instead of from the side, making the construction impossible.
No girth/cinch is shown to secure the saddle; it is just sitting on the wooden rail.
Several saddle panels, skirts, and flaps are smoothly fused together with unclear seams, giving a slightly melted construction.

name: Water Tower
defects: Side spout pipe appears fused into the metal band/tank wall without a clear valve or mounting plate.
Support structure is incomplete/ambiguous: rear legs are mostly missing or hidden, leaving the tank looking supported by only the two front legs and a central dark post.
Cross braces under the tank intersect/fuse awkwardly and do not clearly attach to all legs.
Bottom of the wooden tank bulges downward unevenly in the center, making the tank base look warped.

name: Silver Spur
defects: Rowel wheel is mounted as a solid decorative star on the side of the shank instead of sitting between a forked yoke, so it could not spin like a real spur.
Center axle/rivet of the rowel is fused into the shank and rowel face with no clear separable wheel mechanism.
Rowel points are uneven and melted-looking, with inconsistent sizes and spacing.
Buckle tongue/prong appears as a rounded blob on the outside of the buckle rather than passing through a belt hole.
Leather strap path through the buckle is unclear/impossible, with the strap end and buckle frame visually fused.
Right hanging leather section twists and narrows unnaturally and appears partly merged into the metal heel band.
Metal heel band has an overly smooth warped transition into the long shank, with no clear joint or separate neck structure.

name: Holster Belt
defects: A mushroom-like handle/peg grows vertically from the middle of the belt instead of from the holster; it does not resemble a real revolver grip and is in the wrong place.
The holster appears empty or missing the actual pistol/revolver that the visible handle would imply.
The round sheriff badge buckle is decorative only: there is no functional buckle tongue, belt holes, or clear fastening construction, and the belt seems to continue behind/through it.
The front belt strap and belt loop overlap in an impossible/fused way near the center, making the belt path unclear.
The holster mouth is warped and irregular, with an unnatural wavy opening.
Several stitch marks are unevenly spaced and appear to float or not follow the leather edges consistently.

name: Wheel Bench
defects: Left wagon wheel is partly incomplete/obscured, with the hub mostly missing or hidden and spokes not clearly meeting at one center.
Right wagon wheel spokes are unevenly spaced and some appear to merge into the rim/arm support rather than connecting cleanly.
Armrests and wheel rims are fused together in places, making the construction look carved from one piece rather than separately joined parts.
The two side wheels do not match exactly in visible size and spoke layout.
No text or digits present.

name: Stagecoach
defects: Front of the coach is malformed: the passenger cabin, front window, and front box/hood merge into an impossible single shape with no clear driver's seat or hitch area.
Right-side/front lantern is attached to the side of the window frame rather than a realistic bracket and appears partly floating.
Left/front lantern is embedded into the center pillar instead of mounted on a bracket.
Front axle and wheel assembly is inconsistent: the visible front wheels are different sizes and positions, and the axle does not align cleanly through both wheels.
Rear wheel and front wheel proportions are inconsistent, with the front-left wheel oversized compared with the far front wheel.
Roof railing posts are unevenly spaced and appear to pierce into the roof and luggage.
Top luggage pieces overlap the roof railing awkwardly and appear partially fused with it.
No visible horse pole, shafts, or towing connection for the carriage.
No text or digits visible.

name: Belt Buckle
defects: Horseshoe nail holes are unevenly spaced and not mirrored between left and right sides.
The two squared top ends of the horseshoe are different shapes and angles.
Braided rope border has slightly inconsistent segment sizes around the oval.

name: Rodeo Barrel
defects: Horseshoe emblem is not bilaterally symmetrical: the two arms have different curvature and thickness, the top ends are different shapes, and the nail holes vary in size and position.
Rope bands have uneven/melted twist geometry; several rope segments fuse together smoothly and change size around the barrel instead of forming a consistent rope.
Barrel stave grooves are irregular and do not align cleanly between the body and the top lid planks.
Top construction is ambiguous: it looks like an open rim with a flat sealed lid/plank surface recessed inside, rather than a clear real barrel opening or lid.

name: Fringed Chaps
defects: Belt/buckle construction is ambiguous: the strap, holes, and buckle tongue do not clearly interlock like a real belt.
Top waistband and leather panels are fused into a toy-like continuous piece with no clear rear straps or functional attachment points.
Left and right fringe strips are uneven in width and spacing, with some strips appearing partially fused together at their bases.

name: Show Saddle
defects: Only one stirrup is visible; the matching stirrup on the far side is missing or completely hidden.
The visible stirrup appears only loosely connected to the saddle fender, with no clear continuous stirrup leather/strap supporting it.
The buckled hanging strap on the right does not connect to the visible stirrup and appears to hang as an unrelated extra strap.

name: Chuck Wagon
defects: No text or digits visible.
Front hitch/drawbar has no realistic hitch loop or yoke; it ends as a blunt metal-capped block.
Front right wheel is only partially visible and appears tucked under the wagon body without a clear axle connection.
Wheel axle/underframe construction is unclear; the visible wheels do not share an obvious continuous axle.

name: Rodeo Spurs
defects: rowel wheels are shaped like soft flower petals instead of functional pointed spur wheels
rowel wheels appear fused directly to a single metal shank rather than mounted in a fork with a visible axle
leather straps/cuffs attach to the metal spur bodies in unclear, partially fused ways
no real buckle, tongue, or fastening mechanism is visible on the leather straps; the star medallions act like decorative buttons only
strap holes are uneven and placed inconsistently around the cuffs
